lessons.title: Practice Script Automation File Processing
lessons.description: Finish filter_log_lines. Automate text file filtering and line processing in Python. The test checks that filter_log_lines(['INFO: ok', 'ERROR: fail'], 'ERROR') equals ['ERROR: fail'].
lessons.solution_code:
def filter_log_lines(lines: list[str], keyword: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line for line in lines if keyword in line]
